Register the wallet unit and get a challenge (nonce for the platform attestation and the holder key binding) + Token | POST /dw/v1/holder-keys/challenge (DW endpoint 01)

Sign the DW challenge with the holder private key
Sign the wallet attestation request proof with the instance key

holder key attestation : Android certificate chain / iOS App Attest assertion

[SPEC] DW guidance : at least 10000 entries per list , published at DW endpoint 16

key_storage_status entry = the shared entry of the key storage type (Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0 section 10.5.2 item (a))

header : x5c = wallet provider certificate (no iss)
cnf = instance key of this app , client_status = { uri of DW endpoint 16 , idx }
Issue the WIA (wallet instance attestation) signed with the wallet provider key of DW
header : x5c = wallet provider certificate (no iss)
attested_keys = holder public key , key_storage = level from the platform evidence
key_storage_status = shared entry of the key storage type , no nonce (no issuer at activation)
Issue the key attestation signed with the wallet provider key of DW

Wallet unit activated , WIA , key attestation , holder key registered
• Appendix D (MUST) the key attestation nonce is the c_nonce when the issuer has a nonce endpoint
[SPEC] the activation WIA and key attestation show the wallet unit is activated , they are not sent to VCVP Core
VCVP Core has a nonce endpoint , so each credential request gets a new WIA and key attestation with its c_nonce (part 2 section 8)
[DATA STORE] Store the WIA and the key attestation of this wallet unit
[SPEC] request : CitizenId , deviceId registered with the holder key , credential type = OrgCode , Source , ServiceCode , IdP ID token
Request a credential + Token (from Tang Rat login) | POST /dw/v1/issuance/requests (DW endpoint 03)
Validate Token and CitizenId (CitizenId = Token owner)
(also checked against pid of the IdP ID token in 1.3)
CitizenId (from the request , checked with the Token)

[Holder key of this device not registered]

Load the signing keys of the IdP that issued the ID token (cached)
signature (IdP JWKS , ES256) , iss = IdP , aud = client_id registered with the IdP , exp , nonce
Check pid in ID token = CitizenId of the request

auth_time stored as last authentication timestamp

Use identity assurance profile stored at last login
[DATA STORE] identity assurance profile : identityAssuranceId , citizenId , IAL , AAL , KYC source , KYC timestamp , assurance expiry , last authentication method and time
[SPEC] two callers : DW Core (this flow) and agency systems (system to system) | steps marked caller channel = WALLET run only for DW Core
[SPEC] VCVPAuditLog for every request , also those rejected at the Consumer-Key check (OrgCode and Actor empty) , kept 7 years
Get the default schema of the requested credential type | POST /api/credential-schema/v1/get-by-organisation (VCVP Core 07)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) and its permission for this endpoint

• 15.5.4 403 when the caller is known but not allowed
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)

Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 1.4.1 to 11 do not apply

then its default schema (CredentialSchemas.CredentialTypeId , IsDefault = true)
[Credential type or default schema not found]

Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 1.4.2 to 11 do not apply
Map CredentialSchemaId to ENGINE_CREDENTIAL_SCHEMA_ID and the engine to call
[SPEC] one central WALLET Consumer-Key , issued by VCVP administrators to DW Core only | the agency opts in per schema , checked again in section 5
[SPEC] WALLET (DW central Consumer-Key) : the agency allows requests from the wallet on this schema (CredentialSchemas.AllowWalletRequest)
other channels : the schema belongs to the caller's organisation
[Wallet request not allowed by the agency]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = WALLET_REQUEST_NOT_ALLOWED , EngineCalls)
Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 1.4.2 to 11 do not apply
200 | schema details + Claims[] (ClaimId | Path | Name | Type | Required)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 : who read which schema (EngineCalls)
200 | CredentialSchemaId , RequiredLoA (of the credential type , CredentialTypes) , schema details + Claims[] (ClaimId | Path | NameEn | NameLocal | Type | Required)
Take RequiredLoA of the credential type (section 1.4)
[SPEC] assurance still valid (assurance expiry) , meets the required freshness , IAL level >= RequiredLoA
[Assurance invalid / expired / not fresh / IAL below RequiredLoA]
(VC not issued , this request ends here)
Response of 1.2 : request step-up verification or re-KYC | reason , RequiredLoA

ask the user to verify identity again in Tang Rat before continuing
Submit verification result (new IdP ID token) | POST /dw/v1/identity-assurance/step-up (DW endpoint 04)
Verify new ID token (same checks as above)
[DATA STORE] Store updated identity assurance profile in DW database

Look up applicant data in DW database

WALLET : CredentialSchemas.AllowWalletRequest = true | other channels : OrgCode is the organisation of the caller's Consumer-Key

IssuerIdentityId and IssuerKeyId are optional : identity of the schema owner and ACTIVE , key of that identity (Keys.IdentityId) and ACTIVE
a key with Keys.Status = REVOKED (compromised) : FailureReason = ISSUER_KEY_COMPROMISED (Key-Compromise-sequence)
Validate the request against the schema
(default schema , claims , issuer identity and key when sent)

MessageCode , Message (HTTP status of the error)

Repeat sections 2 to 5 (fetch the applicant data again , new SyncDate)

Look up agency organisation in Organizations table (OrgCode)
[SPEC] issuer DID = CredentialSchemas.IssuerIdentityId , or IssuerIdentityId when the caller sent it
[SPEC] key status RESERVED / ACTIVE / DEPRECATED / REVOKED , one ACTIVE key per identity , more than one = configuration error
VCVP Core always sends issuer and issuerKey to the engine
[SPEC] key = the ACTIVE key of that DID set by the agency (Keys.Status = ACTIVE , Keys.IdentityId) , or IssuerKeyId when the caller sent it
sent to the engine as issuerKey , stored in Credentials.IssuerKeyId (section 6)
[Organisation / issuer DID not found , or more than one ACTIVE key]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08
Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 5.1.1 to 11 do not apply
[Organisation and issuer DID found , at most one ACTIVE key]
[SPEC] this check at issuance is a VCVP policy , the wallet (DW Core) checks the issuer again (part 2 sections 7 , 9)

question : which fields will list them , and how to match them with the engine vct (it changes per schema version)
[SPEC] issuer DID and signing key listed (ServiceDigitalIdentity) , organisation and service status = active , validity period current , credential type (vct) within the issuer scope
Look up the issuer in the cached Issuer Trusted List (iss.txt , ETDA Trusted List Load)
[AUDIT LOG] proof that the issuer passed the Trusted List check at issuance (VCVPAuditLog.TrustCheck)
trust validation result stored in TrustCheck.Result
Trusted List reference (LoTESequenceNumber , entity id) stored in TrustCheck.RegistryReference
Written once with the audit record of this request , never updated
Keep trust validation result (for the audit record of VCVP Core 08)
Validate the issuer passed every Trusted List check
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (FailureReason = TRUST_FAILED , TrustCheck)
Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 5.2 to 11 do not apply
Check the issuer key from section 5.1 (Keys.Status , Keys.ExpiryDate)
[Next key reserved in the issuer DID is available]
[SPEC] the reserved key is already in the DID (added when the DID was created , VCVP Core 03)
the switch changes only Keys.Status , no engine call , the next issuance sends the new key as issuerKey
Switch issuerKey to the next reserved key in the DID
[No reserved key left in the DID]
[SPEC] no key is created during issuance , the agency creates a key (VCVP Core 02) and adds it to the DID (VCVP Core 40) in setup
• 12.6 (MUST) Trusted List update within 24 hours after a rotation
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (FailureReason = ISSUER_KEY_EXPIRED)
Issuance stops here , credential not added , sections 6 to 11 do not apply
[SPEC] old key = DEPRECATED , kept for verification , new key for new credentials | compromised key : Key-Compromise-sequence (VCVP Core 36)
Mark the old key as DEPRECATED (Keys.Status)
Map the issuer DID and key to ENGINE_ISSUER_IDENTIFIER_ID and ENGINE_ISSUER_KEY_ID
Use ClaimId from the request as the engine claim id
(CredentialSchemas.Claims[].ClaimId is the claim id created by the engine)
[ENGINE RULE] the credential is created unsigned (state CREATED) , no status list index yet
the engine signs it when the wallet requests the credential (part 2 , VCVP Core 16)
[SPEC] request : credentialSchemaId = ENGINE_CREDENTIAL_SCHEMA_ID , issuer = ENGINE_ISSUER_IDENTIFIER_ID , issuerKey = ENGINE_ISSUER_KEY_ID
protocol = OPENID4VCI_FINAL1 , claimValues [ claimId , path , value ]
CredentialSchemaId , IssuerOrganizationId , IssuerIdentityId , IssuerKeyId , CitizenHashId (hash of CitizenId , cannot be turned back , the raw CitizenId is not stored) , SyncDate
[DATA STORE] Store credential in Credentials table
• appendix 8.1 D.2 (proposal) tx_code recommended for IAL2.1 - 2.2
[CONDITION] When this runs : only for credential types with RequiredLoA IAL2.1 or higher
their schema is created with transactionCode (NUMERIC , 6 digits) , IAL1 types have no transactionCode and skip the tx_code steps
the user must enter the code before the pre-authorized_code expires (300 seconds) ,
otherwise the user asks for a new code and the offer is renewed (part 2 section 8)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 : which credential was issued , to whom , by which issuer key (TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId , OfferUrl = null , IssuerTrust (Result , CheckedAt , RegistryReference)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , caller channel = WALLET , ActorType = CITIZEN
url , expiresAt , transactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[DATA STORE] Update the same credential in Credentials table : set OfferUrl and OfferExpiresAt , Status = PENDING
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 09 : when the offer link was created for the credential (EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt + TransactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[ENGINE RULE] schema transactionCode = { type NUMERIC or ALPHANUMERIC , length 4 to 10 , description }
share returns transactionCode only for such a schema , every share returns a new code
expiresAt , transactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
transactionCode goes only into the response to DW Core , it is not logged and not stored
[DATA STORE] Store offer in Credentials table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 : which credential was issued , to whom , by which issuer key (TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.CredentialId)
200 | CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt + IssuerTrust (Result , CheckedAt , RegistryReference) + TransactionCode (only when the schema has transactionCode)
[ENGINE RULE] no webhook when an offer expires | INTERACTION_EXPIRED only after the task INTERACTION_EXPIRATION_CHECK runs
[SPEC] scheduled job : PENDING and OfferExpiresAt passed , engine PENDING or INTERACTION_EXPIRED -> OFFER_EXPIRED , engine OFFERED -> keep PENDING
a renewed offer sets PENDING again | credential_accepted later still sets ACTIVE
[DATA STORE] Store CredentialId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt in DW database (issuance request) , IssuerTrust is not kept (DW Core checks the issuer itself in part 2 section 7)
DW Core resolves the offer next (part 2 section 7) and then answers request 1.2
[Response has TransactionCode (credential type with RequiredLoA IAL2.1 or higher)]
issue : how the tx_code reaches the user is not decided (OpenID4VCI 3.5 : not the offer channel)
question : which channels (SMS , e-mail) , where the verified contact comes from , what if the user has none
Send tx_code by SMS or e-mail to the verified contact of the user (second channel)
the code is not logged and not stored after it is sent
